text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary group (usw2 + eu-west-1) for release v3.2.0 has crossed rollback thresholds. error_rate 3.4% (>2%), lat_p95 +40ms. Suggest auto-rollback to v3.1.9 for canary cohort. Suggested action: auto-revert. logs: https://ci/reports/2100005555
Alex P: holding — don't auto-revert without ops in the loop. we need customer impact check and a short comm before a full revert. tagging Ops Oncall. :eyes:
Samira: I see the spike started right after the new KV cache behavior. p95 from 180 -> 220ms, errors are mostly 500s from inference server in eu-west-1. Can reproduce locally with short seq tests.
Ria K: two dedicated customers (acme-inc, betaai) have elevated error rates in eu-west-1, they're on the canary routing split. Acme is seeing 45% request failures. We should notify them ASAP.
Maria L: I'll draft a quick customer note. Template: "We observed increased errors affecting inference requests in eu-west-1 for the canary release v3.2.0. We're rolling back the canary to the previous version (v3.1.9) while we investigate. Expected impact: brief increase in latency during the rollback window; no data loss." Want to confirm phrasing.
Alex P: ok. Ops Oncall, can you take the exec? prefer partial rollback (70/30) first if it's safe. If failures persist, escalate to full revert.
Ops Oncall: taking this. I'll start with a 70/30 traffic shift back to v3.1.9 for canary. If error_rate doesn't drop below 1.5% within 5m, escalate to full rollback. Executing now.
deploy-bot: COMMAND SUGGESTION:
```
deployctl traffic-shift --env canary --from-version v3.2.0 --to-version v3.1.9 --percent 70
```
Ops Oncall: running the above. patching routing and pinning canary pool to v3.1.9 once 70% shift completes.
Samira: quick note — if KV cache change is the culprit, a partial rollback should reduce bad cache entries. watch KV-miss and inference 500 logs.
Ria K: I'll send repo owners + acme-inc + betaai the draft now. pinging account teams.
Maria L: posted customer note to #customer-notify-drafts, sending after Ops confirms shift started. cc: legal for the wording.
deploy-bot: TRAFFIC SHIFT COMPLETE: 70% -> v3.1.9, 30% remains v3.2.0. metrics: error_rate dropped from 3.4% -> 1.6% in 2m. p95 improved by ~20ms.
Alex P: nice. hold 10m observation window, then decide full rollback vs. let canary continue at 30%. Also patch release notes to mark the revert and the KB link for the regression tracker. Samira can you prepare the release-notes patch?
Samira: on it. I'll add a short "reverted canary to v3.1.9 due to increased inference 500s in eu-west-1; root cause investigation ongoing" entry and link the runbook.
Ops Oncall: after 10m watch, if error_rate stays <=1.8% we keep partial split and schedule a maintenance window to fully roll forward once fix is verified. If it creeps back up, auto-escalate to 100% rollback.
Ria K: acme-inc and betaai acknowledged. Acme asked for ETA on full fix — told them we'll follow up after the investigation and share timeline within 4h.
Maria L: sent customer comms. Added note to status page: "Investigating higher error rates in eu-west-1; partial rollback in progress for canary users."
Alex P: good comms. Please create a short postmortem ticket and assign SLO/regression owners. Also add rollback notes to the release doc.
Samira: created ENG ticket #ENG-4721 and linked logs + reproducer. I'll start a deeper bisect on KV cache change.
deploy-bot: ACTION LOG: manual partial rollback executed by Ops Oncall at 2100005612. Traffic shift command and pin recorded. Auto-rollback suppressed per Alex P request.
Ops Oncall: closing loop — will monitor for 30m then update this thread. tagging @Alex P for signoff if we escalate to full rollback. :white_check_mark:
Alex P: thanks team. good call to avoid immediate full revert, this minimized customer impact. keep updates short here.
Ops Oncall: 30m observation update: error_rate holding ~1.5%, p95 stable. keeping partial split. next steps: schedule change window for full revert/forward depending on findings.
Samira: note for follow-up — add regression test exercising long prefix + KV cache write path. I'll PR tests today.
Ria K: customer follow-ups queued. I'll set reminders for 1h and 4h updates.
Maria L: I'll prepare post-customer email template for follow-up and internal comms for release notes.
deploy-bot: THREAD CLOSED (for now). Recorded actions: partial rollback to v3.1.9, customer comms sent, ENG-4721 created.
